description_en: Modifies the automatic start and stop policy for a Supabase instance
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb modify-supabase-auto-scale-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-id sbp-tyarplz0000 --auto-scale false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySupabaseAutoScalePolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Supabase project. You can obtain the workspace ID from the Supabase page in the console
parameters.help_zh: Supabase项目的ID。您可以登录控制台Supabase页面，获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic start and stop. Valid values:
true: Enabled. After this feature is enabled, Supabase automatically pauses and resumes based on traffic conditions.
false: Disabled. After this feature is disabled, the automatic start and stop feature of Supabase is turned off
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用自动启停。
取值说明：
true：启用。启用后，supabase会根据流量情况自动暂停和自动恢复。
false：关闭，关闭后，会关闭supabase自动启停功能
parameters.name: auto_scale
